title: Excited-State Photophysics Improves Scaffold-Robust Phototoxicity Prediction and Reveals Compound-Specific State Effects: Reproducibility Archive
description: Code, frozen out-of-fold predictions, statistical analyses, computed molecular-state tables, higher-level Q-Chem validation summaries, completed matched-state Q-Chem input/output records, environment manifests, and publication figures supporting a computational study of excited-state-aware phototoxicity prediction.
